architecture_delta.mechanism: A thin product boot boundary persists the one-time internal initial grant in a user-state location and delegates all Clay language/compiler/VM/ClayOS semantics to the existing canonical entry. The one-file builder freezes this boot boundary as the EntityOS executable entry.
state_safety: atomic tempfile write plus fsync plus replace
unsafe symlink or permissions fail closed
test-only acceptance requires explicit isolated ENTITYOS_STATE_HOME
architecture_delta.authority_boundary: The persisted internal grant is not Linux/host authorization and does not bypass consequential effect gates, provenance checks, provider authorization or owner authority.

grf.hypothesis: A persistent launch-time state boundary can satisfy one-time EntityOS internal approval continuity without minting new Clay semantics or weakening the canonical effect boundary.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: A persisted grant can become an authority bypass or a mandatory companion installation artifact, violating fail-closed effect semantics or the one-file release law.
grf.discriminator: Build the exact one-file EntityOS, require missing state to fail closed, admit the grant only in an isolated explicit test state root, verify mode/schema and unchanged state across the second launch, corrupt permissions and require fail-closed behavior, then rerun canonical EntityOS gates.
grf.predicted_if_hypothesis: First acceptance persists; second launch does not reprompt; state tamper is rejected; canonical compiler/VM/ClayOS and one-file gates stay green.
grf.predicted_if_counterhypothesis: The second launch requires another grant, modified/unsafe state is accepted, canonical gates regress, or runtime requires a release sidecar/install dependency.

primary_external_evidence.relevance: XDG_STATE_HOME is the standardized location for user-specific application state intended to persist between restarts.
One-file frozen runtime behavior supports treating the release executable as the packaging boundary while keeping modular source as build input.

negative_results_and_limits: The final graphical one-click first-start UX is not implemented; current normal TTY launch uses one explicit text confirmation.

The persistent grant records intended internal capability classes but does not yet prove that every future network/media/state capability implementation consumes the grant through a single non-bypassable policy path.
